name: Wych

bonuses.name: Power from Pain: Flensing Fury
bonuses.text: If this Threat deals a Wound it gains +3 bonus dice to Weapon Skill (I) Tests until the end of its next Turn.

abilities.name: Torturous Acrobatics
abilities.text: The Wych moves to their target then uses a Multi-Action to make an Athletics (S) Interaction Attack attempting to make them Vulnerable, followed by a melee attack with their Hekatarii Blade

abilities.name: No Escape
abilities.text: When this Threat makes a Reaction Attack with a melee weapon they do so with +2 bonus dice

determination: Dodge: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 3d6. This Threat uses Agility instead of Toughness to roll Determination.
note: Another printing exists: litanies-wych (Litanies of the Lost).
